research_review.title: Self-augmenting technical indicator with recurrent reinforcement learning: evidence from Forex markets
research_review.assessment: Reviewed 15M RRL alternative. Mean positive test Sharpe on only USDJPY/EURCHF; other six mean results negative. Best seed/test-checkpoint performance is not an ex-ante selector. Not represented as reproduced or profitable here.

interpretation: Formula availability is not verified forex profitability. Every rule, session, stop and budget adaptation is experimental and recorded before its results are evaluated.
